C6.claim: Betti table of the dual module is the reverse of that of M
C6.construction: M* = graded dual Hom_k(M,k), M*_(-d) = (M_d)^*; right module by (f.u)(m) = f(um); left module through the antipode S(x) = -x, S(y) = -y, S(z) = -z: (u.f)(m) = f(S(u)m); matrices of x, y on M* are minus the transposes of those of M. Reverse means beta_{i,j}(M*) = beta_{3-i,4-j}(M) (resolution of k ends in U(-4)).
